tasks.short: Advise the Finance Director and HR on the cost of pay, benefit, tax or system choices.

steps.what: Take the question and agree its scope with the requester
Pull payroll, headcount, flex and ledger data into Excel
Model scenarios such as CAO indexation, pension or flex mix
Write the advice memo with options and risks

loop.input: scenario model outputs and question scope
loop.output: draft memo with figures linked to model cells
loop.check: every number in the text is matched against the model; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: two drafts; then the accountant writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: the explanation of trade-offs is free text that a template cannot write

steps.what: Discuss the advice and answer follow-up questions

tasks.design: A scheduled extract on the governed data platform joins AFAS payroll, headcount and ledger data with agency hours into one cost baseline. A parameterised scenario workbook (CAO rise, pension premium, flex share) reads it, and a bounded model step drafts the memo with every figure tied back to the model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each question needed a fresh hand-built extract from AFAS and agency portals, so there was no stable baseline to reuse.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a reusable extract and scenario model cheap to build; a model can draft the explanatory text once figures are fixed.
tasks.still_hard: Questions vary a lot, and long-range tax or pension advice depends on judgement and on rules that change.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing what the Finance Director and HR actually need to decide, and saying clearly where the numbers are uncertain.

ambition.what: Cost every CAO or flex-mix proposal before each OR or negotiation meeting, not only once a year.

tasks.altitude: Less time building spreadsheets, more time in the room where pay and staffing choices are made; the accountant owns the cost model used in those decisions.

reach.task: Benchmarking and costing pay and benefit changes
reach.learn: How CAO scales and allowances drive the payroll cost per site
How the scenario model can feed the forecast directly

evidence.claim: Models beat junior CPAs on detailed month-end tasks but not on client communication and asking the right questions.
Judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck in full accounting tasks.
Tax estimates belong on the mandatory human review list.

assumptions: Advice is internal to Noordhaven management, not to outside clients.
Payroll data is accessible to the accountant at aggregate level.
unknowns: How many advice requests arrive per year and on which topics.
Whether the works council must consent to using payroll data in a new platform under the WOR.
research_questions: Which of last year's advice requests could have used one shared cost baseline?
Can AFAS payroll data be exported at the needed detail without individual salary exposure (AVG)?
Does the Finance Director trust a model-drafted memo if every figure is linked?

tasks.short: Test whether new or changed finance systems and interfaces will post and control correctly before go-live.

steps.what: Read the design, mapping and planned process changes

loop.output: list of affected accounts, VAT codes and controls, with page references
loop.check: each item cites a passage; the accountant confirms or deletes
loop.stop: one pass per document; unclear items go to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: design documents are free text with no fixed structure

steps.what: Write test cases with expected postings and controls
Run test transactions in the AFAS test environment
Compare actual postings to expected and log breaks
Write findings and the go or no-go advice

tasks.design: A reusable test harness in Python posts scripted test transactions through the AFAS Profit connectors into the test environment and compares results with expected postings, VAT codes and approval flows. A bounded model step turns design documents into a draft risk list; the accountant signs the go-live advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test runs were manual clicks in AFAS and comparison in Excel, too slow to repeat after each design change.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a scripted AFAS test harness quick to build and to extend per project.
tasks.still_hard: Spotting what the design leaves out, and getting a test environment with realistic data.
tasks.human_edge: Judging which control gaps matter for the audit and the close, and saying no to a go-live.

ambition.what: Rerun the full finance regression test before every AFAS update, not only for big projects.

tasks.altitude: From clicking through test cases to designing the test set and owning go-live sign-off for finance controls.

reach.learn: How payroll and HR changes post to the ledger
Which real invoice cases should become test cases

evidence.claim: Multi-step reasoning across files is a main failure mode for models.
Unnoticed model assumptions make workpapers hard to rebuild.
E-invoicing for B2B is planned from July 2030, a likely future system change to test.

assumptions: Noordhaven has an AFAS test environment.
AFAS connectors allow posting test entries.
unknowns: How many system projects per year touch finance.
Whether IT allows scripted writes to the AFAS test environment.
research_questions: Which past go-lives caused audit adjustments or close delays?
Can the AFAS test environment be refreshed with anonymised production data?
How long does one manual test cycle take today?

tasks.short: Report on asset use and audit results to management and recommend changes.

steps.what: Extract the fixed asset register and usage data
Reconcile assets to the ledger and calculate use per site
Gather open audit findings and their status

loop.input: utilisation figures, trends and findings status
loop.output: draft commentary per site and per finding
loop.check: tie-out of every figure in the text to the dashboard; flagged mismatches block release
loop.why_not_simpler: the commentary explaining causes is free text

steps.what: Present to the management team and agree actions

tasks.design: A nightly job joins the AFAS fixed asset register with ledger and fleet or forklift usage data and feeds a Power BI page on use, idle assets and book value per site. Audit findings move from a mail-and-Excel log into a SharePoint list with owners and due dates, and a bounded model step drafts the commentary with a tie-out gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Usage data sits outside AFAS and had to be matched by hand to asset numbers each time.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes the matching job and the Power BI page cheap; Power BI and SharePoint are already licensed.
tasks.still_hard: Usage data from fleet and warehouse equipment may lack asset numbers, so matching needs a mapping someone maintains.
tasks.human_edge: Recommending which assets to sell, move between Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, or replace, and holding owners to audit actions.

ambition.what: A monthly idle-asset review per site instead of a yearly report.

tasks.altitude: From assembling the report to running a monthly asset review with site managers; the accountant proposes disposals and transfers.

reach.task: Managing audit follow-up with the external auditor
reach.learn: Which findings the auditor tests again
How utilisation data changes the replacement plan

evidence.claim: Management reports suit deterministic software plus model-written commentary with review.
Models can add unnoticed assumptions, so figures need a tie-out to source.
AI use in accounting firms was linked to a 7.5-day faster close.

assumptions: Fleet and forklift usage data can be exported from an operational system.
The audit findings log lives in Excel or mail today.
unknowns: Which system holds truck and forklift usage hours.
Whether asset numbers in AFAS match operational equipment ids.
research_questions: What share of assets can be matched to usage data automatically?
Would site managers act on a monthly idle-asset list?
How many audit findings stayed open past their due date last year?

role.altitude: The accountant moves from building extracts and test runs by hand to owning the cost model, the finance test set and the asset review that management uses to decide.
reach: Controller: audit follow-up and close controls
FP&A Analyst: personnel cost and capex forecasts
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: costing CAO and benefit changes
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: AFAS change testing
skills_to_grow: Writing and maintaining test scripts against AFAS connectors
Building Power BI pages on the governed data platform
Reviewing model-drafted text with tie-out checks
Presenting recommendations to the management team
role.ambitious_version: One shared finance data layer on AFAS where every advice question, system change and asset review starts from tested, reconciled data, so the accountant can cost any proposal within a day and rerun finance regression tests before every AFAS update.
